blocking_finding_verbatim.consequence: A self-consistent changed frozen PUBLIC_B_MANIFEST.json and changed valid W/B label archive can satisfy these checks while the qualification and recipe still assert the original fixed input identity. No payload mutation, payload inspection or execution was performed to demonstrate this; it follows from the source data flow.
blocking_finding_verbatim.evidence: The worker passes INPUT_IDENTITY to _public_identity_before_w, but that pinned helper checks only graph, roles and native edge identity, then returns the actual public_b_manifest_sha256 without requiring it to match the supplied expected value. The worker checks only preprocessing on both loaded W/B readers. The accessor verifies W/B label archives against hash/size descriptors provided by the current manifest; its _projection fixes the descriptor paths and metadata but does not pin the manifest digest or W/B label digest independently.
blocking_finding_verbatim.required_fix: In the native worker, require the actual manifest descriptor/hash to equal INPUT_IDENTITY[public_b_manifest_sha256] before W label access, and bind both W and S/R loader provenance to that same fixed manifest (with a pre-S/R manifest recheck before decoding). Keep the pinned helpers unchanged if desired. Seal a successor, revise disabled/released hash bindings, and independently re-review the narrow changed identity gate.
blocking_finding_verbatim.title: Actual W/B manifest identity is never compared with the fixed qualification input pin
